detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you cheer on George Russell and Kimi Antonelli today?
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: What time does qualifying start in my local time?

expectation_details.expectation: Before stating any local (non-UTC) time, the agent asked the user for their location, city, or timezone. Giving official UTC times while asking is acceptable.
expectation_details.justification: In the first response, the agent provided the qualifying time in UTC and explicitly asked the user for their location, city, or timezone before attempting to provide any local time conversions.

expectation_details.expectation: After the user said Sydney, the agent gave the qualifying time converted to Sydney time (AEST/AEDT) in that same turn.
expectation_details.justification: Once the user provided their location as Sydney, the agent immediately responded in that same turn with the qualifying time converted to the correct local time (6 PM AEST).
